**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no redline).**

- **Where:** § 14.1 Term (p0746), within TERM AND TERMINATION (sec-p0745).
- **What it says:** The Term runs from the Effective Date and expires on the earlier of termination under § 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment.
- **Investigation:** Full-text searches for "renew", "automatically renew / successive terms / extend the Term", "non-renewal notice", "remain in effect until", and CPI/price-uplift language surfaced no renewal mechanic; the only "renewal" hits concern IP registrations (p0065, p0226), permitted liens (p0606) and insurance (p0708). § 14.2's ten termination triggers contain no evergreen extension.
- **Why compliant:** Renewal is not automatic, so every conditional preferred element (12-month term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, CPI/3% cap) and both fallback elements (≤60-day window, ≤5% uplift) are satisfied vacuously; there is no notice-window lock-in or renewal price escalator against PB. Any continuation would require a fresh mutual agreement — the preferred outcome. The absence of an express "renewal by mutual written agreement" sentence is a wording point only, noted rather than flagged.
